senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch.woe; (interj.) oh! woe! Targ. Prov. XXIII, 29 ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. וָיָא or וַיָא). —
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 120:5">Targ. Ps. CXX, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
Gen. R. s. 26 לא ישלה ווי מפומך the word woe shall never cease from thy lips.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ווי דלא וכ׳</he> woe that my son does not eat &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:4">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ו׳ לדין כד וכ׳</he> woe to this one (Esau), when that one (Jacob) shall rise.

Meg. 16ᵃ ויי מביתא וכ׳ woe from inside, woe from outside! Ib. 11ᵃ (play on vayhi, Esth. I, 1) ויי והי הדא וכ׳ (Ms. M. ויי הוה מה וכ׳; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. marg. note in ed.) woe and grief, as it is written &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the preformative וַי in the Imperfect with Vav Conversive.—Pl. וַויִּן.
units: Snh. 70ᵃ י״ג ו׳ נאמרו ביין thirteen times do we read vay (woe) in the chapter about wine (Gen. IX, 20 to 24); Gen. R. s. 36. כתיב בה ו׳ י״ד פעמים fourteen times &c. (Gen. IX, 20 to 25).
